inspiration.observed_pattern: The source demonstrates recursive CTE traversal over parent-child rows and separately demonstrates deterministic JSON_OBJECT aggregation inside GROUP_CONCAT for structured child output.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a department hierarchy report. A recursive CTE carries each root ID, depth, and slash-delimited node path through descendants, then a grouped projection emits one JSON_OBJECTAGG node map per traversed node. The source schema, identifiers, JSON fields, and hierarchy values are not copied.

fixture_notes: Finance is one root with Payroll and Treasury children, and Payroll has a Benefits grandchild. Support is a second root with a single Helpdesk child. Each traversed node must emit exactly one keyed JSON object containing its full path and name, with depth and root identity preserved.
determinism_notes: Node IDs, parent links, names, recursion depth, path construction, unique JSON keys, and final root ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE report_units (unit_id INT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INT NULL, unit_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO report_units VALUES (10, NULL, 'Finance'), (11, 10, 'Payroll'), (12, 10, 'Treasury'), (13, 11, 'Benefits'), (20, NULL, 'Support'), (21, 20, 'Helpdesk')

steps.sql: WITH RECURSIVE unit_tree (root_id, unit_id, parent_id, unit_name, depth, unit_path) AS (SELECT unit_id, unit_id, parent_id, unit_name, 0, CAST(unit_name AS CHAR(255)) FROM report_units WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT parent.root_id, child.unit_id, child.parent_id, child.unit_name, parent.depth + 1, CONCAT(parent.unit_path, '/', child.unit_name) FROM unit_tree AS parent INNER JOIN report_units AS child ON child.parent_id = parent.unit_id) SELECT root_id, unit_id, depth, JSON_OBJECTAGG(unit_path, unit_name) AS node_map FROM unit_tree GROUP BY root_id, unit_id, depth, unit_path ORDER BY root_id, unit_id
